sandbox.copied: Copied: settings, roles, organization structure, custom fields, policies, workflows, approval chains, time off types and policies, schedule templates and branding.
sandbox.notCopied: Never copied: people, users, documents, absences, timesheets, the audit log, sign-in methods, API keys, webhooks and audit streams.

customBranding.description: Your logo and accent color in the app.

branding.lead: Show your logo and use your accent color for links and buttons.
branding.resetDone: Accent color reset to the default.
branding.accentBody: To keep the app readable for everyone, the color must meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on every background, in light and dark mode.
branding.separateDark: Use a different color in dark mode
branding.rejected: This color was not saved because it does not have enough contrast:

off.body: Your organization has not turned on the Ask HR assistant. Contact HR with your question.

settings.body: Ask HR lets employees ask questions about your policies. It answers only from the policy documents you choose, cites them, and tells people they are talking to AI. It never makes or recommends employment decisions, such as hiring, pay, performance, promotion, discipline or termination. It is off until you turn it on.

refusal.employment_decision: I can't make or recommend decisions about people, such as hiring, pay, performance ratings, promotion, discipline, termination or layoffs. I can explain what your company's policies say about these processes. For a decision, speak to HR or the manager responsible.

askHr.disclosure: You are talking to an AI assistant. It answers only from your company's policy documents and can make mistakes, so check the cited source. It never makes or recommends decisions about hiring, pay, performance, promotion, discipline or termination.

rota.title: Schedule
rota.legend: Dashed shifts are drafts that employees can’t see until you publish the week.

kiosk.invalid: Employee number or PIN not recognized.

matrix.intro: Licenses, certifications, background checks and training required by job title, location or entity, with expiry dates and reminders.
matrix.emptyBody: Add the licenses, certificates and training your roles need.

document.certificate_of_registration_or_naturalis: Certificate of registration or naturalization as a British citizen with a National Insurance number document

email.paymentFailedSubject: Payment failed for your Thapsus-HR invoice {number}
email.paymentFailedBody:
Hello,

We couldn't process the payment of {amount} for invoice {number} for {company}. It is due on {due}.

Please update your payment details on the billing page:
{link}

Your workspace stays available while you do this. If you've already paid, you can ignore this email.

Thapsus-HR billing

billing.title: Billing
billing.regionNote: Your billing details and invoices are stored in {region}.
billing.ownersOnly: Only the company owner can manage billing.
billing.contractBody: Billing follows contract {reference} for the {plan} plan, from {start} to {end}. Invoices are due within {days} days. Contact your account manager to make changes.
billing.invoiceCollection: Paid by invoice, due within {days} days. PO number: {po}
billing.changeRules: Upgrades start now with a prorated charge. Downgrades and switching from annual to monthly start at the end of the period you have paid for.
billing.chooseLead: You keep any free trial days left; you are charged when the trial ends. Every workspace gets {days} days free.
billing.currencyLocked: The currency is fixed once a paid subscription has started.
billing.taxNote: Tax is added where it applies.
billing.nowProrated: Takes effect now. Estimated charge for the rest of this period: {amount} before tax.
billing.atPeriodEnd: Takes effect on {date}, at the end of the period you have paid for.
billing.cancelConfirm: Cancel your subscription? It ends at the end of the billing period after a {days}-day notice period, and you keep full access until then.
billing.countryHint: Two letters, for example GB, DE or US.
billing.taxIdTypeHint: For example gb_vat, eu_vat or us_ein.
billing.contactHint: Invoices and payment problems are sent here.
billing.stripeNote: We share only your company details and your billing contact with our payment provider, Stripe. We never share employee data.

support.title: Support
support.subject: Subject
support.priorityHint: Urgent means the service is unusable for your company (admins only).
support.descriptionHint: Include the steps to reproduce it. Please do not include sensitive data such as health information.
support.attachmentHint: PNG, JPEG, PDF, text or CSV, up to 10 MB.
support.privacyNote: Your ticket is stored in your workspace's home region. Our support team can read what you send here, and nothing else in your workspace without an admin's permission.
support.hoursLine: Support hours: {start} to {end}, Monday to Friday ({zone})
support.alwaysLine: Support is available around the clock.
support.closedNote: This ticket is closed. Raise a new ticket if you need more help.

meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Simple, published prices per employee, by company size. Monthly or annual, with a free trial.

pricing.title: Fair prices, published for everyone
pricing.lead: Pay per active employee, with lower prices as you grow. Monthly plans roll with no lock-in; annual plans cost less.
pricing.trialBadge: Free for {days} days, no card needed
pricing.enterpriseTerms: Annual contracts, invoicing with payment terms and purchase orders

core.name: Core
core.summary: Everything to run people records, documents and time off.

plus.name: Plus
plus.summary: Core, plus schedules, time tracking, workflows and compliance tools.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.summary: For large and multi-entity organizations, with 24/7 support.

bands.title: Prices by company size
bands.lead: The price for your whole company follows its number of active employees ({term}). Prices exclude VAT and sales tax.
bands.caption: Price per employee per month in {currency}

trial.title: Free trial
trial.body: Every workspace starts with {days} days free. Choose a plan when you are ready.

monthly.title: Monthly
monthly.body: No lock-in. Cancel at any time with {days} days' notice; your plan ends at the end of the billing month after the notice period.

annual.title: Annual
annual.body: Save {percent} by paying yearly. Give {days} days' notice before your renewal date to stop it renewing.

changes.title: Upgrades and downgrades
changes.body: Upgrades start right away and you pay only the difference for the rest of the period. Downgrades start at the end of the period you have paid for.

tax.title: Tax
tax.body: VAT, sales tax and reverse charge are calculated by Stripe Tax for your billing address.

currency.title: Currency
currency.body: Pay in pounds, euros or US dollars. Your currency is set when your first paid subscription starts.

meta.title: Service status
meta.description: Live status of Thapsus-HR in the United Kingdom, the European Union and the United States.

statusPage.title: Service status
statusPage.lead: Each region runs separately, so each is reported separately. Status is refreshed every 30 seconds.
statusPage.unavailable: We can't load this region's status right now. Please try again shortly.

help.title: Help center
help.forThisPage: Help for the page you were on
help.noResultsBody: Try different words, or raise a ticket and we will help.
help.stillStuck: Still need help? Our support team can look at it with you.

signin.title: Staff sign-in
signin.lead: For Thapsus staff only. Every action is recorded.
signin.totpLead: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
signin.codeHint: Six digits. Codes change every 30 seconds.
signin.note: Multi-factor authentication is required for every staff session.

overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: This cell serves {region} ({aws}). Customer data from other regions is never shown here.
overview.privacy: Customer personal data is only visible through support access that the customer grants, and every access is logged in their audit log and in the staff trail.

tenants.title: Customers
tenants.cellLead: Customers homed in this cell, with usage totals only.
tenants.allLead: Every region, from the global directory: identifiers, regions, plan and status only.

tenant.aggregatesOnly: Totals only: no names or records.
tenant.grantNone: You have no support access to this customer's data.
tenant.accessLogged: Opening a record needs the customer's support grant and is written to their audit log and the staff trail.
tenant.noGrant: No active support grant from this customer. Ask an admin to grant access from Settings.
tenant.billingLead: Group legal entities into separately invoiced accounts. Billing contacts are entered by the customer and are not shown here.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.lead: Turn features on or off for this workspace. Changes are written to the customer's audit log and the staff trail.

plans.title: Plans and contracts
plans.lead: Plans and prices come from the billing configuration ({location}, version {version}, from {date}).
plans.discounts: Annual discount {annual}. Discount codes: {codes}. Free trial: {trial} days.

contracts.title: Enterprise contracts
contracts.endConfirm: End this contract? Billing stops at the end of its end date.
contracts.newLead: Custom prices are stored on the contract record. Activating it bills each of the customer's billing accounts by invoice.

support.title: Support queue
support.lead: Tickets from customers in this cell, most urgent first. The queue shows routing details only; opening a ticket is logged.
support.auditNote: You can see this ticket because the customer sent it to support. This view is recorded in the customer's audit log and the staff trail.
support.grantNote: To look at anything else in this workspace, the customer must grant support access.

status.title: Status page
status.lead: Post incidents and planned maintenance for this region. Posts appear on the public status page.
status.noPersonalData: Public text: never include customer names or personal data.

rules.title: Jurisdiction rule data
rules.lead: Rule values come from the jurisdiction packs. Corrections are added as new dated versions; nothing is overwritten.
rules.addLead: Use the official government source. The newest version wins where periods overlap.
rules.badJson: The value must be valid JSON.

lawChanges.title: Law changes
lawChanges.lead: Entries in the law-changes feed. Customers see published entries for the jurisdictions where they have entities, locations or employees.

audit.title: Staff audit trail
audit.lead: Every staff action in this cell. The trail is append-only.

settings.title: Support contact channels
settings.lead: Contact options shown to customers in {region}, per plan. Saving adds a new version; earlier versions are kept.

form.identityNoteHint: Describe the check. Never record ID numbers or copies of documents.

retention.policiesLead: Automatic deletion is off until you turn it on for a category. You can keep data longer than the law requires, never shorter.

legal.noticesLead: Start from a template for each jurisdiction, edit it for your company and publish it. Templates are drafts for legal review.

ui.lead: Handle data subject requests within their legal deadlines, keep data only as long as needed, and manage your account data, incidents and legal terms.

closure.certificateBody: All data of workspace {workspace} was deleted from the database, file storage and caches on {date}. Backups expire automatically by {expires}. The certificate follows.

hero.lead: Choose where your data lives. We keep it there, encrypt it, isolate it from every other customer and give you the tools to meet your own privacy obligations.

dsr.body: Access exports, corrections and erasure, with legal deadlines for CCPA, UK GDPR and GDPR.

payslips.title: Pay stubs
payslips.mine: My pay stubs and tax documents
payslips.noneBody: Your pay stubs and year-end documents appear here when payroll publishes them. We will let you know.
payslips.upload: Upload pay stubs or year-end documents
payslips.labelHint: Shown to employees, for example “May 2026” or “2025”

integrations.noRules: No rules yet: new accounts get no licenses or groups.
integrations.intro: Create, license and block accounts in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace when people join and leave. Your administrator grants consent, you choose the licenses and groups, and every step can be previewed first.
integrations.googleDelegation: Authorize client ID {clientId} with the scopes listed above in the Admin console, then verify.
integrations.serviceAccountHint: The client ID your super admin authorizes for domain-wide delegation

note.absenceMethod: Approved absence overlapping the period, in working days of each person's work pattern, excluding public holidays. Vacation and comp time are not included.
note.liabilityMethod: Leave earned but not taken by the date, valued at contractual base pay: annual pay ÷ (52 × working days per week).

holidayLiability.title: Vacation liability
holidayLiability.description: The value of time off earned but not yet taken, per currency.
